title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1581: Catalog page (3)

section.p: “A bone? What are you talking about?” Su Yu asked, “How did they look like?”
Tian He answered by drawing something out. When Su Yu looked at the drawing, he noted that it resembled a humerus. Did Tian He somehow enter the arm of Old Zhou?

Su Yu rubbed his chin and completed the story for Tian He, “As you travelled, you found another divine weapon. A smaller divine weapon. It was very long as well. As you went forward, you found five more weapons. They were akin to chains linked together. Am I right?”
Tian He exclaimed in surprise, “You went there as well? Why didn’t I see you?”

Su Yu shrugged without answering. Sure enough, Tian He had entered Old Zhou’s arm. Su Yu was quite surprised to hear that. How did that happen? Death spirits would be teleported to the first underground level. Meanwhile, a pseudo death spirit like Tian He would be teleported inside the arm. Was that the case?

Speaking of, what about the other pseudo death spirits? A decent number of pseudo death spirits had entered the mansion this time, such as the water elemental, shadow, and the others. Su Yu had been too busy to look for them so he was unsure of their fates. He was unsure if they had left with Xia Longwu and the others.

If they weren’t with Xia Longwu and the others, they were probably dead. The humans would most likely take them along upon encountering them since Hong Tan knew them. After all, Hong Tan was the one who had captured them in the past. Tian He was stronger, so he had survived alone.
Tian He continued asking in shock, “Su Yu, were you there as well? Did you collect the divine weapons there?”
He was certain those were divine weapons. They were terrifyingly powerful.
Collecting?
Su Yu rolled his eyes. Nonsense. Those were Old Zhou’s bones. Anyone attempting to collect them would be beaten to death.
“No. Stop thinking about them. Be thankful you were weak enough to even move them.”
Clearly, Tian He wouldn’t hesitate to take Old Zhou’s bones away if he could. How brave of him.
“Su Yu…those are definitely divine weapons!”

“Divine weapons are not for people like you to dream of. That applies to even me.” Su Yu asked, “And? Anything else? Did you get anything from the mansion? You’re already a Pseudo Invincible. Do you have your second carrier treasure?”
Tian He sighed, “Don’t even talk about that anymore. There were so many treasures there, but I couldn’t take even one. Why would I be so sad here otherwise?”

His sigh was filled with bitterness. He felt like he had returned from a treasure vault empty-handed. Any single weapon there would be more than enough for him. After all, even a heaven weapon was already good enough to serve as a carrier treasure.

“Sure. Keep sulking here. I might gift you one if you do contribute something to the ancient cities in the future, but only if I have excess. For now, I’ll be using what I have for myself since you have yet to contribute anything.”
“That’s only natural.”

Tian He did not mind that. He continued sighing. He was greatly saddened by this trip to the mansion. After struggling for an entire month, he had returned empty-handed. In fact, his mental state was quite impressive for him to not go mad after such a massive disappointment.
He had never seen so many divine weapons before. Where else could he find so many divine weapons? Alas, he was only lucky enough to see those weapons but not leave with them.

In fact, he was so sad that he no longer felt anything when Heavendoom shouted at him after his return. He didn’t care anymore. He was more than happy to see Su Yu become the mayor. That would only reduce the burden on him.
What a pity that he had returned empty-handed.
“That guy has gone mad.”
The moment Su Yu met Heavendoom, he heard Heavendoom grumbling, “In the past, he was terrified of me. But now, he has gained the courage to ignore me!”
Heavens! Heavendoom couldn’t even believe this. Was Tian He actually such a courageous person?
Su Yu chuckled, “That’s not surprising. Anyone returning empty-handed after seeing so many treasures would go mad.”
“Was he telling the truth?”
“Most likely.” Su Yu said, “But those are not divine weapons. They are probably the bones of Martial Emperor. But the bones of such a person might as well be divine weapons.”
Heavendoom said, “I thought he was either lying or tricked by some illusions. So you mean he actually saw all those treasures?”
“Yeah.”
“In that case, his madness is understandable.”
Heavendoom shook his head and said, “I would go mad as well. Divine weapons are attractive to even someone like me.”
He continued, “Bones…teleportation…Human Face World…all these are truly curious.”
Su Yu laughed, “What’s curious about that? Everything is so obvious.”
Heavendoom said, “If that’s really the case, Martial King was truly ruthless back then. Is this Martial Emperor still alive?”
“Probably.”
“Martial King…no, the Human Emperor and Culture King were around back when the mansion was built. These people…were truly ruthless.”

Heavendoom had a vague idea of what had happened all those years ago. He didn’t even know what to say about it. A living supreme expert had been forged into a mansion, surviving in such a state for countless years. This was an even worse fate than what the guardians had suffered.
After all, the Luminous Domain Mansion was older than even the Allheaven Battlefield. The supreme expert had been turned into a mansion for more than a hundred thousand years.
Heavendoom asked, “Was his head stabbed into the ground?”
Heavendoom thought about it and laughed in amusement, “What about the Devote King’s Residence? What’s the location?”
Su Yu shrugged and said, “Don’t ask me. I don’t know.”
“Hahahahaha!”
Heavendoom was greatly amused. He said, “Devote King was not a good guy. Back then, he spent so much time disciplining me. Hahahahaha! So his home was actually someone else’s…hahahahaha!”

Heavendoom roared with laughter. It was as though his grudge from a hundred thousand years ago had finally been dissolved. That bastard Devote King was the one who had sent them here, causing them to be stuck as stone statues for a hundred thousand years.

If it wasn’t for the fact that Devote King was already dead, Heavendoom would have gone mad and attacked the Devote King long ago. Thus, he was greatly pleased to learn about the truth behind Devote King’s Residence.
Su Yu said helplessly, “Enough laughing, Lord. Can I have the record character?”
“Uh…” Heavendoom blanked out for a long while before recalling what Su Yu was talking about. He asked, “You need it?”
“Maybe. I’ll accept it if it’s good enough. Otherwise, forget it.”
“Heh.” Heavendoom said, “That’s my spoils of war.”
What was the kid thinking, asking for that?
“You get three or five extra days outside.”
“Ah? Three or five?” Heavendoom sneered and said, “The record character is a very valuable treasure.”
“Seven or eight days.”
“Hehe…”
Su Yu turned around directly and said, “Forget it. You can keep the character.”
“No!” Heavendoom shouted, “Come back! Including the three days you promised me previously, I’ll get half a month in total! I want to go out and party for half a month!”
“No problem.”
Su Yu agreed easily. It was no big deal.
Far away, Wan Tiansheng was looking on with a blank expression. So a supreme treasure even the Heavenly Overseer Marquis longed for was mere worth half a month outside the city.
How…lamentable. How sad.
And Su Yu was truly a scumbag for toying with the guardians like this.

Su Yu was naturally unbothered. As far as he was concerned, the character was useless for Heavendoom. Or to be precise, the character would be useless for most people. Bountiful Treasure wouldn’t have given it up so easily otherwise.
Thus, the character was worth about half a month’s holiday.
That was all.
Before long, he received the character.
It was a golden fragment with the record character embedded in the middle of the fragment. It was also written in the willpower language.
Was this the so-called record character?
The moment Su Yu held it in his hand, the golden book in his head trembled slightly.
It seemed to be reacting.
The previously inactive fragment reacted as well. It started glowing faintly.
As for Su Yu, his vision blurred.
When his gaze landed on the record character, he felt as though numerous paintings, numerous people, and numerous auras were dancing in his vision.
Record.
Recording. Gathering. Storing. To bear the weight of history.
Numerous figures flickered in his eyes. He saw Wan Tiansheng. He saw September. He saw Skyeater.
His mind went blank.
A catalog.
Yes. This was a part of a catalog with some unique functions. It was capable of supervising the world. No genius could escape being recorded by this catalog.
Alas, he only had a mere fragment in his hand. The catalog was incomplete.
“It has broken apart…” Su Yu muttered to himself. How did something so powerful break apart?

Did it break apart due to the death of its master? Or was it simply broken by someone? He had heard that the catalog had remained in the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion all along. It was unlikely that it had suffered the attack of an expert. The Heavenly Overseer Marquis would have died before something like that happened. In that case, was the damage to the catalog a result of the destruction of these characters upon the death of their master?

No, that wasn’t right. The record character was still around. Did the Culture King do this deliberately? He couldn’t return anymore. Or he foresaw his own death. Since he didn’t want the complete catalog to fall into the hands of Heavenly Overseer Marquis, he had damaged it from afar.
Was that why? That was the most probable likelihood. Otherwise, the characters wouldn’t have remained intact while the catalog itself broke apart.
“The Culture King…broke it himself.”
Did a part of the complete catalog find its way into his head during that time?
“How odd.”
Countless questions emerged in Su Yu’s mind. Why didn’t the Culture King hand him the complete inheritance, then? He couldn’t understand.
Even more scenes were appearing in his vision. He continued focusing. Eventually, he saw…the Heavenly Overseer Marquis.
